1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi. Ni iya bene Kōra.

2.text: Mwa mahanga yose mwe, nimukome mu mashyi,Muvugirize Imana impundu z'abanesheje.

3.text: Kuko Uwiteka Usumbabyose ateye ubwoba,Ari Umwami ukomeye utegeka isi yose.

4.text: Atugomōrera amoko tukayatwara,Ashyira amahanga munsi y'ibirenge byacu.

5.text: Adutoraniriza umwandu wacu,Ni wo byirato bya Yakobo uwo yakunze.Sela.

6.text: Imana izamukanye impundu,Uwiteka azamukanye ijwi ry'impanda.

7.text: Muririmbire Imana ishimwe,Muririmbe ishimwe,Muririmbire Umwami wacu ishimwe,Muririmbe ishimwe.

8.text: Kuko Imana ari Umwami w'isi yose,Muririmbishe ishimwe ryayo,Indirimbo ihimbishijwe ubwenge.

9.text: Imana itegeka amahanga,Imana yicaye ku ntebe yayo yera.

10.text: Abakomeye bo mu mahanga,Bateraniye guhinduka abantu b'Imana ya Aburahamu.Kuko ingabo zikingira abo mu isi ari iz'Imana,Ishyizwe hejuru cyane.
